queue.name: nobody-asked-admin
queue.oidcAudience: Use the exact Cloud Run HTTPS task URL

objectStorage.ledgerLifecycle: retain; never apply the export lifecycle to deletions/

runtime: Cloud Tasks Enqueuer on the selected queue
Service Account User on the task service account
Storage Object Creator and Viewer on the selected bucket
Storage Object User restricted to objects under exports/
iam.taskInvoker: Application verifies the Google ID token, exact audience, and expected service account. The existing public service remains public.
iam.restoreOperator: Read the independent ledger and write only the explicitly selected isolated restored database.
iam.unchanged: No runtime deployment, restore, IAM administration, billing, or database administration permissions.

requestLogExclusion.name: nobody-admin-oauth-callback
requestLogExclusion.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="nobody-asked-api" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/requests") AND httpRequest.requestUrl =~ "/admin/auth/callback([?]|$)"

logging.applicationLogs: Keep fixed authentication result events and private audit records. Do not log callback URLs, codes, ID tokens, cookies, CSRF values, or request bodies.
